name: urbanflow
description: UrbanFlow Mobility - multimodal urban mobility platform (T6 CDSD - RNCP 36146)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace packages/shared && npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
